purpose: Language feasibility screen, not primary inference, a population estimate or journal-readiness certification
reader: one real author-reader; limited model-ID blinding, not independent validation
duplicate_normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, collapse whitespace; do not repair generated text
required_label_fields: all fields in the blank author-reader CSV, including genuine rater_id, evidence and actual positive elapsed_seconds
missing_labels_decision: pending; never infer a human pass
pass_decision: both backbones satisfy all criteria, followed by recorded evidence review; no automatic post-matrix authorization
fail_decision: preserve every sample/rating; hold post matrix and reconsider or stop feasibility within existing caps; do not change seed or threshold to obtain a pass
threshold_rationale: A descriptive 75% conditional screen excludes a broad writing failure before costly logic comparisons. It is an engineering planning choice, not a validated statistical cutoff or proof of fluent/chat-capable models.
